title: Summer Morning · complete poem
instructions: 真人历史作品朗读，非现代场景对话或官方试卷。先独立听音并完成6题，再提交核对；录制署名不出题。级别只是编写目标，未做真实考生难度标定。来源与署名可在开始后查看；若打开外部全文或原音，后续继续按已见材料记录。
transcript:
The cocks have now the morn foretold,
The sun again begins to peep,
The shepherd, whistling to his fold,
Unpens and frees the captive sheep.
O'er pathless plains at early hours
The sleepy rustic sloomy goes;
The dews, brushed off from grass and flowers,
Bemoistening sop his hardened shoes
While every leaf that forms a shade,
And every floweret's silken top,
And every shivering bent and blade,
Stoops, bowing with a diamond drop.
But soon shall fly those diamond drops,
The red round sun advances higher,
And, stretching o'er the mountain tops,
Is gilding sweet the village-spire.
'Tis sweet to meet the morning breeze,
Or list the gurgling of the brook;
Or, stretched beneath the shade of trees,
Peruse and pause on Nature's book,
When Nature every sweet prepares
To entertain our wished delay,—
The images which morning wears,
The wakening charms of early day!
Now let me tread the meadow paths
While glittering dew the ground illumes,
As, sprinkled o'er the withering swaths,
Their moisture shrinks in sweet perfumes;
And hear the beetle sound his horn;
And hear the skylark whistling nigh,
Sprung from his bed of tufted corn,
A haling minstrel from the sky.

questions.prompt: What does the shepherd do near the start?
questions.evidence: Unpens and frees the captive sheep.
questions.explanation: Unpens and frees 两个动作都说明把羊放出来。

questions.prompt: What makes the rustic’s shoes wet?
questions.evidence:
The dews, brushed off from grass and flowers,
Bemoistening sop his hardened shoes
questions.explanation: dews 来自草花；没有提到水桶或正在下雨。

questions.prompt: What do the “diamond drops” refer to in this scene?
questions.evidence:
While every leaf that forms a shade,
And every floweret's silken top,
And every shivering bent and blade,
Stoops, bowing with a diamond drop.
questions.explanation: 前后句描述露水，diamond 是光泽的比喻，不是遗失珠宝。

questions.prompt: What happens to the sun as the poem continues?
options: It rises higher and lights the village spire.
answers: It rises higher and lights the village spire.
questions.evidence:
The red round sun advances higher,
And, stretching o'er the mountain tops,
Is gilding sweet the village-spire.
questions.explanation: advances higher 与 gilding 描述升高并照亮尖塔；场景是清晨。

questions.prompt: Where does the speaker imagine resting while considering nature?
options: On a boat far from the shore
questions.evidence:
Or, stretched beneath the shade of trees,
Peruse and pause on Nature's book,
questions.explanation: stretched beneath ... trees 指树荫下舒展休息；Nature’s book 是读自然的比喻。

questions.prompt: Which bird is heard near the end? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: And hear the skylark whistling nigh,
questions.explanation: skylark 是鸟；前一行 beetle 是甲虫，不能混为一类。
